scenario: Choosing a dish from a menu
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Waxaa la isticmaalaa in la soo bandhigo doorashada.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you like to eat?
dialogue.translation: Maxaa jeclaa inaad cuntaa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I like fish or chicken with rice.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan jeclaa kalluun ama diir la bariis.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The fish is very good here.
dialogue.translation: Kalluunkan waxaa halkan aad u wanaagsan yahay.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Then I try some fish, please.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba waxaan jarribaa qaar baa kalluun, fadlan.

key_phrases.phrase: What do you like to eat?
The fish is very good here.
key_phrases.translation: Kalluunkan waxaa halkan aad u wanaagsan yahay.

scenario: At the bank for a simple transaction
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Qoraalka aan la qariso leh ee Ingiriisi ah: 'money' ma lihidin tirada.
Waxay noqon kartaa mishan ('more money') ama isku-dhex-galka ('more quickly').
Waxaa la isticmaalayaa in la sameeyo mustaqbalka hore.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need money now.
dialogue.translation: Waan baahan yahay lacag haatan.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Here is your card. Go there with your ID.
dialogue.translation: Halkan waa kaararkaaga. Tag halkaan la ID-gaaga.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Will you give me more cash?
dialogue.translation: Miyaad ii siin doontaa lacag badan?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I will give you the money now. Go there.
dialogue.translation: Haa, waxaan ku siin doonaa lacagta haatan. Tag halkaan.
